original_messages.content: Hi, I need to schedule service for my car.
Good morning! This is Mike at Firestone Auto Care. I'll help you schedule service. What kind of service do you need?
I need an oil change and the 30,000 mile service.
Sure thing. What's the year, make and model of your vehicle?
It's a 2019 Honda Accord.
Great. And what's your name?
William Chen.
Thank you, Mr. Chen. Current mileage on the Honda?
Just hit 31,500 miles.
Perfect timing for the 30K service. That includes oil change, tire rotation, brake inspection, air filter, cabin filter, and transmission service.
How much will that cost?
The complete 30K service package is $389.99. Oil change alone would be $44.99 if you wanted to do that separately.
Let's do the full package. When can you fit me in?
I have openings this Friday November 24th at 8 AM, or Saturday the 25th at 10 AM.
Friday at 8 works.
Perfect. That service takes about 2-3 hours. Will you wait or need a ride?
I'll wait. You have WiFi in the waiting room?
Yes, free WiFi and coffee. Phone number for confirmation?
Email for service records?
wchen@techcompany.com
License plate number?
Texas plate JFK-8821.
VIN number for our records?
I don't have that handy.
No problem, we'll get it when you come in. Any specific concerns with the vehicle?
The brakes have been squeaking a bit.
We'll do a thorough brake inspection as part of the service. If you need brake work, we'll give you a quote before doing anything.
Sounds good. What type of oil do you use?
For your Accord, we recommend full synthetic 0W-20. It's what Honda specifies.
Is that included in the price?
Yes, full synthetic is included in the $389.99 package price.
Good. How long is the oil change good for?
With full synthetic, Honda recommends every 7,500 miles or 6 months, whichever comes first.
What about the transmission service?
We'll drain and refill the transmission fluid with Honda-compatible ATF.
Is it a full flush or just drain and fill?
For Hondas, we do drain and fill. Full flushes can sometimes cause issues with Honda transmissions.
I've heard that too. What about the brake inspection?
We measure pad thickness, check rotors for warping, inspect calipers, and test brake fluid.
If I need new brake pads, what's the cost?
Front brake pads with labor run about $179. If rotors need replacing, add another $250.
That's not too bad. What about the cabin air filter?
The cabin filter replacement is included. Helps with air quality and AC efficiency.
Good. My allergies have been bad lately.
A fresh cabin filter will definitely help with that. We use quality HEPA filters.
What about the engine air filter?
That's also included. We'll inspect and replace if needed.
Do you check other fluids too?
Yes, we top off all fluids - coolant, brake fluid, power steering, windshield washer.
What about the battery?
We test the battery and charging system as part of our complimentary inspection.
Mine's probably original from 2019.
So about 5 years old. That's getting to replacement age. We'll test it and let you know.
How much for a new battery if I need one?
Batteries for your Accord run $159-189 depending on the brand, includes installation.
Okay. Do you offer any warranties?
Yes, our service comes with a 12-month/12,000-mile warranty on parts and labor.
That's reassuring. Oh, I also have a Tesla that needs tire rotation.
We can definitely do that. What model Tesla?
2023 Model 3 Long Range.
Current mileage on the Tesla?
About 8,000 miles.
Tire rotation for a Tesla is $29.99. We can do both cars the same day if you'd like.
Actually, let me just focus on the Honda for now. My wife uses the Tesla mostly.
No problem. So just the Honda Accord on Friday at 8 AM.
Yes. How do you handle payment?
We accept cash, check, all major credit cards. Payment is due when service is complete.
Do you offer any discounts?
If you sign up for our email list, you get $20 off your first service.
Sure, sign me up.
Great! That brings your 30K service to $369.99.
Every bit helps. What if you find other issues?
We'll call you before doing any work beyond the scheduled service. No surprises.
That's what I like to hear. Some places just do work without asking.
Never here. We believe in transparency and customer approval.
What time do you open on Friday?
We open at 7:30 AM, but your appointment is at 8 AM.
Can I drop it off early?
Absolutely. We have an early bird drop-off. Just put the keys in our secure drop box.
That's convenient. What's your address again?
We're at 4455 North Lamar Boulevard, Austin. Right next to the Target.
Oh yeah, I know where that is. Easy to find.
Exactly. Plenty of parking too. Your appointment is confirmed for Friday, November 24th at 8 AM.
Wait, that's Black Friday. Are you sure you're open?
Good catch! Yes, we're open Black Friday but with reduced hours, 8 AM to 3 PM.
So I should come early to make sure it's done?
With your 8 AM appointment, you'll be our first customer. Should be done by 11 AM.
Perfect. I can do some Black Friday shopping while I wait.
Target next door will definitely be busy! Your confirmation number is FS-447291.
Let me write that down... FS-447291?
Correct. We'll also send a text reminder Thursday evening.
Great. See you Friday morning!
See you then, Mr. Chen. Have a great Thanksgiving!
